title: fileDatastore
summary: Create a file datastore descriptor object.
description: `fileDatastore(files, Name, Value)` creates a descriptor object for file-backed datastore workflows.
behaviors: The constructor preserves file specifications and common metadata options: `ReadFcn`, `FileExtensions`, `IncludeSubfolders`, and `ReadMode`.
`ReadFcn` is retained as the supplied value, including function handles, so caller code can pass datastore descriptors around without invoking the reader during construction.
Iterator-style operations such as `read`, `hasdata`, and `reset` require the generic datastore dispatch layer and are not provided by this constructor builtin.
